output.content: During the morning order window, I open the monitoring dashboard every fifteen minutes to check the status of the forecast service. The last entry in the shared log shows a manual refresh at 06:45. When a batch job fails, the error appears in the console only after I click the refresh button. I record the timestamp of each manual check in a spreadsheet. There is no automated page sent to the on call engineer when latency increases. The system does not send a notification to the distribution centres if the service is down. I observe the screen to confirm the job completed. The logs show the exact time of my last manual interaction with the interface.
